BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The download can be intercepted anywhere on the network path, such as public Wi-Fi, a proxy or an upstream provider.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: A man-in-the-middle position is needed at the time of the download.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: No account is needed to tamper with the traffic.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The impact stays on the host that downloads the file.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: A replaced executable can read any data on the host.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: A replaced executable can change data and code on the host.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: A replaced executable can disable the host.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
